text.en: Once fluid is filtered by the glomerulus, it becomes urine directly, with nothing further happening to it -- in reality, the vast majority of what the glomerulus filters (water, glucose, amino acids, most electrolytes) is reabsorbed back into the blood as the filtrate travels through the tubule; only a small fraction of the originally filtered fluid, plus a few actively secreted substances, actually becomes the urine that is eventually excreted.
text.et: Kord glomeruluse poolt filtreeritud vedelik muutub otse uriiniks, ilma et sellega midagi edasi juhtuks -- tegelikult reabsorbeeritakse valdav enamus sellest, mida glomerulus filtreerib (vesi, glükoos, aminohapped, enamik elektrolüüte), tagasi verre, kui filtraat liigub läbi tuubuli; ainult väike osa algselt filtreeritud vedelikust, koos mõne aktiivselt eritatud ainega, muutub tegelikult uriiniks, mis lõpuks eritatakse.
